title: A planted patch's report lists new, gone and unchanged findings
author: lane/lab-p2-readers
question: Against the base run's pinned findings, does the heal cut's report list its new, gone and unchanged findings correctly?
hypothesis: A finding id is its reader and its row's scope, so the report's new findings are exactly the rows off under the cut and not off on the base, its gone findings exactly the rows off on the base and not off under the cut, and the rest unchanged. An independent row by row count agrees with the report's diff on every id
